memory_candidates.content: When adding a shared behavior to N agent files that must stay byte-identical across deployed (.claude/agents/) and extension-source (.claude/extensions/core/agents/) copies, edit the deployed copy first, verify with Edit, then `cp` it over the extension-source copy and `diff` immediately — cheaper and less error-prone than editing both copies in parallel and reconciling drift afterward.

When two territory-adjacent tasks will edit the same agent file (e.g. task 781's checkpoint sub-section vs. a future task 779's recovery-reference section in general-implementation-hard-agent.md), give each task's addition its own clearly labeled markdown sub-heading (e.g. '#### Checkpoint Sub-Section: ...') rather than interleaving prose into existing stages. This makes the disjointness verifiable by grep/diff even before the second task exists.
